answer: Run grading under peer prediction: each agent grades samples of submitted work and is paid by how well its grades predict the grades of a random honest panel, using a proper scoring rule. Careful grading pays; lazy rubber-stamping mispredicts and burns stake. So a sybil must make every fake falcon account grade like a real expert: each extra reef of identities does costly work per task, and an orchard of colluders voting as a bloc diverges from the panel and scores negative. Reputation grows through costly work, so mass registration never pays.
